shut.text: A frame of rune-iron taller than you, humming, with lights trapped in it. You'd have to get past the Mercy to touch it.

open.text: Dozens of cages of rune-iron, each with a wisp inside, all wired to a core of pale seam-stone that drinks their light. Pinned to the frame, a note in a clerk's hand: "Warden: if the Fields are found, burn the engine and come to me at Ilunhall. The Empress's light-stone needs us more than she knows. - V."

choices.text: Smash the rune-iron and let them go.

freed.text: The first cage breaks, then the rest, one after another, like ice on a river. The lights pour up through the stones of the ring and out of the sinkhole, and somewhere far above, faintly, someone in Greyfold is laughing.

done.text: Broken rune-iron and a dull grey core. The ring stones are warm.
